correctness.rationale: Correctness PASS. With H=diag(-lambda,lambda), v2/v1=u0 exp(-2 gamma lambda t) except v1=0. The exact position generator is (beta lambda/(1+u²))[(u²-1)I + 2uJ] with J a skew quarter-turn; its radial logarithmic derivative is beta lambda (u²-1)/(1+u²). Exact integration gives exp(-beta lambda t)[(1+u0²)/(1+u0² exp(-4gamma lambda t))]^(beta/(2gamma)), hence a hyperbolic-cosine peak at t*=log|u0|/(2gamma lambda) when |u0|>1, gain ((|u0|+|u0|^-1)/2)^(beta/(2gamma)), and return at 2t*. Direction v1=0 instead makes X'=beta lambda X; the zero position and u0=0 boundaries are explicit. Haar RP1 initial acute angle uniform on [0,pi/2]; for gain >z, theta exceeds (pi-arcsin(z^-2gamma/beta))/2, giving exact arcsin/pi tail and p-moment threshold p<2gamma/beta. Independently checked radial identity, peak and random-tail quadrature for three parameter triples; all-parameter conclusion follows from integration.
